parameters.content:
## Customer Onboarding Automation Workflow

Starter template from agentmelt.com — configure before running:

1. Fill in "Config (edit me)" (name, approver, quiet hours; test_mode stays on for the first week).
2. Add credentials to every service node (Anthropic, mail, CRM, database…).
3. Replace placeholder URLs, queries and field mappings with yours.
4. Set the trigger: The product or billing system posts new signups; a daily Schedule Trigger evaluates every account still in onboarding against milestone deadlines.
5. Keep the gates: 'Needs a person?' after every AI step, 'Approved?' after the approval — wire their dead ends to a sheet or a channel.
6. Keep the guardrails:
   - Nudges are sent only on stalls, with a cap of one per milestone; no message for customers making progress.
   - The setup-question agent answers from documentation with citations and escalates unknowns.
   - High-value accounts get a person on the first stall, not the third.
   - Every automated message is logged on the account so the CSM sees the full history.

Full blueprint and pricing: https://agentmelt.com/workflows/customer-onboarding-automation/
Want it built and run for you? $247/month · custom $3,500–6,000 one-time

nodes.name: Config (edit me)
nodes.notes:
Fill these in once; every later node reads them as $('Config (edit me)').item.json.config.*

test_mode = true: log what the workflow would write, without writing it, for the first week.
approval_mode = true: the approval node waits for a person; switch off per message type once it has earned it.

Also point the nodes at your own sources:
- Signup and plan data (billing or product)
- Product analytics activation events
- Documentation and setup guides (vector store)
- CRM account owner and segment
- Support conversations during onboarding

nodes.name: IF: Detect stalls
nodes.notes:
Detect stalls

A milestone past its expected day with no progress is a stall. Stalls are classified by which milestone, because the fix differs.

options.systemMessage:
You are the "Send the right nudge" step of the Customer Onboarding Automation Workflow workflow run by Agentmelt.
Task: The agent writes a short message for this stall — the specific next step, one link, an offer to help — using the customer's plan and what they have already done. No generic drips.

Rules:
- Nudges are sent only on stalls, with a cap of one per milestone; no message for customers making progress.
- The setup-question agent answers from documentation with citations and escalates unknowns.
- High-value accounts get a person on the first stall, not the third.
- Every automated message is logged on the account so the CSM sees the full history.
- Answer only from the data provided in the input. If something is missing, say so in the output instead of guessing.
- If this step produces a message or a document, put the full text in `draft` (and a `subject` if it is an email); put a one-line summary in `summary`.
- Set `needs_human` true whenever you are unsure, the input is unusual, or a rule above applies; a person will look at it.
- Return valid JSON matching the output schema; no prose outside the JSON.
